Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pihu - 13 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Shalini - 37 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Aditi - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
5. Vimla - 75 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Shalini and Aditi stand near him.]

Aditi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vihaan goes jogging in the park.]

Aditi: "Okay, Vihaan."

[Vihaan catches the ball.]

Vihaan: "I knew it!"

[Vihaan feeds the birds.]

Vihaan: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Pihu, Shalini and Aditi stand near him.]

Aditi: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan runs to Mother.]

Vihaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vihaan jumps with joy.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Vihaan climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Shalini: "Aditi, are you okay?"

[Pihu draws a rangoli at the door.]

Pihu: "Mom, are you okay?"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Pihu (laughing): "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

Vihaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Vihaan yawns loudly.]

Vihaan: "This is amazing!"

[Vihaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Vimla (happily): "That's easy."

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Vihaan is asleep in bed in the bedroom. Shalini stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Vihaan wakes up and rubs his eyes.]

Shalini: "That was such a fun day!"
